$comment: ClaimDesk 247 — Property Damage (Third-Party Motor) sub-tree (VIC) v1. STAGING-UNSIGNED. Per MULTI-STATE-ROLLOUT-PLAN.md: this tree ships with every scenario's legal_signoff stripped so G-PROD-LOCK escalates every VIC PD intake as 'unsigned-scenario' until Legal Head signs it. The CD-R2 claim-farming memo and the PD counsel memo for VIC are prerequisites for sign-off (see handoff/MULTI-STATE-ROLLOUT-PLAN.md §4). Governing frame: common-law negligence (liability) + Arsalan v Rixon; Nguyen v Cassim [2021] HCA 274 CLR 606 (like-for-like hire/recovery) — both federal/HCA, apply nationally. Victoria's road rules are the Road Safety Road Rules 2017 (Vic), which adopt the Australian Road Rules nearly verbatim, so rule numbers match NSW. Victoria's CTP-equivalent is the Transport Accident Act 1986 (TAC scheme) — that is the CTP injury scheme (Lane 2) and is NOT used by this tree; Lane 1 PD recovery is from the at-fault driver's comprehensive insurer (national market). Limitation: Limitation of Actions Act 1958 (Vic) s5 — 6 years for tort. Outside the NSW Claim Farming Practices Prohibition Act 2025 (NSW-only) by definition; Victoria has no equivalent PD-specific statute (the Wrongs Act 1958 (Vic) addresses personal injury only). EVERY scenario here is property-damage-only: any injury mention is firewalled to esc-injury → PI pathway → law-firm partner, never monetized per-referral. Per-tree hashing: this tree's sign-off is bound to its own scenarios[] hash, independent of NSW PD/motor/PL/med-neg. Band enum strictly likely|possible|unclear|insufficient. No numeric fault %.
governing_law: Common law negligence (liability) + Arsalan v Rixon; Nguyen v Cassim [2021] HCA 274 CLR 606 (like-for-like hire/recovery). NOT the Transport Accident Act 1986 (Vic) — that is the TAC CTP injury scheme (Lane 2). Limitation: Limitation of Actions Act 1958 (Vic) s5, 6 years for tort.

rule_citations.title: Keeping a safe distance behind vehicles

rule_citations.rule: Arsalan v Rixon; Nguyen v Cassim [2021] HCA 274 CLR 606
rule_citations.title: Not-at-fault owner's entitlement to like-for-like hire including loss of amenity/enjoyment

Just before impact, your vehicle was:

default_pattern.description: Following driver responsible for safe gap (RSRR r126); not-at-fault front driver recovers repairs + like-for-like hire (Arsalan)

exceptions.probe_question: Did the vehicle in front brake suddenly without apparent reason?

Did the vehicle in front reverse into you?

damage_consistency_check.expected: rear damage on front vehicle AND front damage on rear vehicle
